summary: The comment urges that parents have full control over what their children are exposed to, especially regarding sex and gender topics, and that no counseling or content should be provided without parental consent.

claims.requested_action: Require parental consent for all content involving sex or gender
claims.argument: Parents should have the right to decide what sexual or gender content their children receive.
claims.evidence_quote:
Give parents total transparency as it regards their children & what they are exposed to verbally or in books, films, etc. 
No “counseling” without parental consent on anything especially sex. 
Gender
